1 4:32 How did they suggest fixing the humour cliff??They joked that after working on the problem for ten years, they finally fixed it — by drawing a smiley face on the chart.
2 5:03 What is the secret to finding humour in our lives??The secret is to start noticing what is true — looking for things that are interesting, odd, or amusing in everyday situations. Our brains are wired to find what we set out to look for, so if we look for humour, we will find it.
3 5:21 What influence can "living on the precipice of a smile" have on our lives??It can shift how we interact with the world — making us more open, creative, and connected. It is a choice to navigate life with lightness, which helps us do serious things without taking ourselves too seriously.
